imprint.kevs-tieredz-modifiers.resonance: Resonance — max a weapon's mastery imprint to unlock its unique ability, scaling with stacks

Warlust — deal {rage_threshold} hits to enter rage (resets after {rage_decay_ticks:sec} idle); on enter: heal {heal_fraction%}% HP, gain {damage_bonus_pct%}% melee damage for {warlust_ticks:sec}, {kb_ignore_chance%}% chance to ignore knockback; cone shockwave fires every {cone_cd_ticks:sec}, shaved by {cone_cd_reduction} per hit
Maul — every {proc_every} hits deals {bonus_fraction%}% armor-bypassing bonus damage and stuns for {stun_ticks:sec}, with a {fissure_chance%}% chance to tear a rending line through the earth

Aftershock — fall smash (>{smash_threshold} blocks) stuns the target {stun_ticks:sec} and erupts 3 rings: {wave1_frac%}% / {wave2_frac%}% / {wave3_frac%}% damage at {radius1} / {radius2} / {radius3} block radius

Tempest — charge with {charge_required} melee hits; the next throw pierces, lightning-strikes each target for {chain_damage} damage and homes within {homing_radius} blocks; on pickup, a lightning ring hits up to {max_chain} nearby foes

Siege Shot — charges in {recharge_ticks:sec} (each arrow shaves {shot_reduction_ticks:sec}); fires {damage_bonus} damage piercing shot with {shockwave_radius} block shockwave ({aoe_damage_fraction%}% damage)
Overflow — spells stack {per_stack%}% spell power (max {max_stacks} stacks, resets after {decay_ticks:sec}); projectile spells: {halo_chance%}% chance to spawn {halo_count} orbiting projectiles

Requiem — healing ramps your healing output up to {heal_buff_max%}%. Healed allies gain stacks; at {stacks_required} stacks (or {window_ticks:sec}) a healing quake erupts at them, dealing damage from the healing done and stunning for {stun_ticks:sec}.
imprint.kevs-tieredz-modifiers.sanctifie: Sanctified ({value%}% damage & healing with healing wands/staffs)
imprint.kevs-tieredz-modifiers.spell_sur: Spell Surge (chance on kill to refund spell cooldowns)
imprint.kevs-tieredz-modifiers.mending_g: Mending Grace (chance to double healing spells)
item.tiered.rune_azure.lore: Inscribes a magic imprint when reforged.
item.tiered.rune_radiant.lore: Inscribes a magic or survival imprint when reforged.
